name: Filling in the AI-CAIQ: Instructions and Recommendations
description: Respondent instructions for completing the AI-CAIQ self-assessment questionnaire. Covers which columns to fill, decision rules for the answer and SSRM control-ownership columns, expected level of detail for the implementation-description and customer-responsibilities columns, and how to handle partial implementations and remediation commitments.
relationToCloudSecurity: Governs how vendors describe shared responsibility for AI services running on cloud infrastructure when self-attesting.
relationToAISecurity: Operational guidance for the AI-CAIQ, the vendor-attestation instrument for AICM. Required reading before a STAR for AI Level 1 submission.

license.notes: CSA publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

lifecycle.notes: Ships as a PDF inside the AICM v1.1 ZIP bundle. VERSION IS BUNDLE-DERIVED: the document itself states no version number. It is filed as v1.1 because it ships with — and describes the column layout of — AI-CAIQ v1.1.0. If CSA reissues it unchanged with a later bundle, reconcile rather than assuming a new version.

current_extraction.notes: 3-page PDF with a clean text layer; no OCR forcing needed. Section hierarchy preserved.

notes: Refers to questionnaire columns by spreadsheet letter (C, D, E, F). Those correspond to the AI-CAIQ v1.1.0 layout: C = Service Provider AI-CAIQ Answer, D = SSRM Control Ownership, E = Service Provider Implementation Description, F = Service Customer Responsibilities.

desired_end_state.notes: Short narrative guidance with no per-item structure to extract. Markdown is the appropriate terminal form.
